nonclaims.statement: No kit has current dogfood run evidence, measured results, or green status in this artifact.
No production readiness claim is authorized by these backlog records.
No public SLA or public SLO claim is authorized by these backlog records.
No tenant workload readiness or tenant workload safety claim is authorized.
No hyperscaler maturity claim is authorized; these records are prerequisites only.
Future kit execution must use dogfood-controlled environments; external SaaS or public-cloud fallback does not satisfy the evidence gate.

doubt_driven_review.risk: Backlog rows could be mistaken for passing production-quality evidence because they enumerate concrete scenarios and gates.
doubt_driven_review.resolution: Every kit row is pending_implementation/not_implemented/evidence_required, green status is not_claimed, required future receipts are explicit, official sources are allowlisted, and the validator rejects maturity/readiness overclaims.
doubt_driven_review.remaining_gap: Actual harness code, dogfood cluster/vfkit execution, evidence records, and production-100 green decisions remain future stories.
